text: Altruism cannot be relied on in a decentralized anonymous system, so fees are ultimately crucial; the authors conclude that several blockchains with different fee structures must exist so that different transaction values can be given correspondingly different security.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Secure Proof of Stake Protocol (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3125827
